summary: Iteration 9 - Kiosk Exit PIN feature. Backend pytest 10/10 passed (validation, set/verify/clear cycle, 5-fail 429 lockout via X-Forwarded-For, GET/boot never leak kiosk_pin_hash, empty PIN keeps existing). Frontend Playwright end-to-end: Server dialog kiosk-pin-section shows BELUM DIATUR then AKTIF after save with clear checkbox appearing; runtime with PIN set hides runtime-toolbar and shows kiosk-exit-hotspot (64x64 top-right), 3s hold opens kiosk-pin-dialog, wrong PIN shows 'PIN salah' via kiosk-pin-error, correct PIN closes dialog, strips ?kiosk=1 and toggles data-kiosk to false with toolbar visible; no-PIN kiosk shows runtime-toolbar + runtime-exit-kiosk-btn and no hotspot; non-kiosk runtime shows runtime-kiosk-btn. Env restored: kiosk_pin cleared, workspace 'Scada by T4bun', hide_engineer false, no logo.
critical_code_review_comments: system.py kiosk_verify: lockout counter _pin_fails is in-memory per-process. In multi-worker deploys each worker has its own counter, weakening the 5-fail lockout. Consider persisting in Mongo with TTL or Redis if horizontal scale is required.

system.py kiosk_verify: when lockout expires, the 'n' counter is not reset before the next attempt (it stays incremented up to whatever value <5). Behavior is fine because it only trips at n>=5 then resets, but slightly non-obvious; a small comment or explicit reset when now>=until would improve clarity.

KioskPin.jsx: hotspot uses onPointerLeave to cancel the 3s timer; on touch devices, small finger movement outside the 64px zone cancels unlock. Consider tracking movement threshold or accepting cancellation only on pointerup/pointercancel for better mobile UX.

Runtime.jsx line 87: kiosk state also triggers when display-mode is fullscreen/standalone even without ?kiosk=1; combined with brand.kiosk_pin_set that means launching the PWA locks the toolbar until the correct PIN. Intended, but worth documenting for the user.
